institutional.label: Teacher-child interactions
institutional.ask: Watch a lead teacher for ten minutes. Do they kneel to eye level, ask open questions, build on what a child says, and settle conflict calmly?
a: Directive, mostly managing behavior; little conversation
Warm, but talk is short exchanges
Sustained back-and-forth; teachers extend children's thinking

institutional.label: Classroom environment and daily rhythm
institutional.ask: Are materials open-ended and in reach? Is there real outdoor time? Does the day flow without long waits or whole-group sitting?
a: Sparse or cluttered; lots of waiting
Rich, organized, child-accessible; daily outdoor play

institutional.label: Curriculum and tracking progress
institutional.ask: How do they document progress (portfolios, observations)? Do they screen development? How often do they share progress with parents?
a: Informal notes; one conference a year
Written observations, screening, two or more conferences a year

institutional.label: Teacher qualifications and stability
institutional.ask: Lead teachers' degrees and ECE units? Average tenure? How many teachers left last year? Will your child's teachers likely still be there next fall?
a: Degreed leads, 7+ year average tenure, low turnover

institutional.label: Ratios and group size
institutional.ask: Adult-to-child ratio for three-year-olds, and total group size in one room.
a: 1:6 or better, groups of 16 or fewer

institutional.label: Health, safety and licensing record
institutional.ask: Check the state record for serious (Type A) citations and complaints. Ask what changed after any citation.
a: Clean record in the last five years

institutional.label: Leadership and governance
institutional.ask: How long has the director been in the role? Is the board independent of the director and founders? Does the school publish its financials?
a: Tenured director, independent board, open books

institutional.label: Financial durability
institutional.ask: Will the school be healthy through your child's last year? Look at reserves, the deficit trend and debt.
a: Negative net assets or a large loan
A year or more of reserves, stable or growing

institutional.label: Family partnership
institutional.ask: How do teachers communicate day to day? Is there parent education? Are you welcome in the classroom?
a: A real partnership: conferences, visits, parent programs

family.label: Path to your kindergarten targets
family.ask: How many children applied to your target K-8 schools in the last three years, and how many were admitted? How does the director support the kindergarten application?
a: Documented placements and active, personal K counseling

family.label: Teaching style match
family.ask: Does what you see in the classroom match the approach you want (for example play-based, Montessori, Reggio, Vygotsky-style scaffolding, arts-led)?
a: Exactly what you hoped to see

family.label: The teacher your child would have
family.ask: Meet the actual lead teacher for your child's age group. Can you picture your child thriving with this person for a year?
a: Both parents want this person teaching your child

family.label: Values and community
family.ask: Is there visible diversity of families? How does the school talk about kindness and inclusion? Does any faith framework fit what you want?

family.label: Parent community and time demands
family.ask: Required co-op hours, fundraising expectations, and whether these are families you'd enjoy for years.
a: Light demands and families you'd seek out

family.label: Daily logistics
family.ask: Walk or drive time, drop-off and pick-up versus your work hours, extended care, calendar and summer.

family.label: Privacy and children's photos
family.ask: Which app do they use for photos and messages? Do they post children publicly? Opt-in or opt-out?

family.label: Home language and culture
family.ask: If a home language matters, do classrooms reflect it, and are there bilingual staff?

family.label: Cost and value
family.ask: Tuition, extended care, fees and the giving expectation, set against everything above.

family.label: Would we both be happy choosing this school?
family.ask: Answer after the tour, separately, before you compare notes.

gates.label: Your child is eligible on the start date (age cutoff, toilet training)
No serious licensing citation or unresolved substantiated complaint
No serious risk the school closes or shrinks before your child finishes
Any religious framework is acceptable to both parents
The photo and social media policy works for your family
